criteria.revision: Make the concrete detail more exact: “Cubone wears its deceased mother’s skull, and no one has ever seen its real face.”

criteria.quote: Is level 28 the real trigger, or does acceptance matter?
criteria.revision: Sharpen the conflict without claiming the lore overrides the game mechanic: “Does level 28 explain only when Cubone evolves, or does the Moon entry suggest what the evolution means?”

criteria.quote: The number tells us when. The skull suggests what that change means.
